In Your Corner is a marketplace for online counseling and coaching services. Through a secure, HIPAA-compliant platform, our service connects users with a carefully curated team of wellness professionals. By conducting online consultations via video chat, written journals, and even texting sessions, we have transformed traditional therapy into an experience that is low-cost, convenient, and completely confidential.

Everyone can benefit from an objective perspective during difficult times, but the current model for supportive services is broken due to insurance gridlock, a clunky referral system, long wait times and unsustainable costs. Our web-based approach offers valuable guidance through accessible and anonymous means. Users log in to secure accounts and speak with licensed professionals on a variety of topics—relationship conflict, job stress, etc.—from anywhere at any time. With our proprietary technology, we have removed every barrier to entry and created an outlet for millions who wouldn’t have sought emotional health services otherwise, reducing stress for an increasingly stressed-out generation. This is the future of mental health. 

The shift in moving counseling services online is inevitable and our product is already in demand: After a successful pilot with Pretty Padded Room, an online therapy website specifically targeted towards millennial women, we are excited to relaunch as In Your Corner, an aspirational brand that provides the very best in counseling, coaching, and calm. In Your Corner improves on our original offering by being more gender-inclusive and convenient. In addition to developing a mobile app to provide one-tap, on-demand support in real time, users also have access not only to licensed mental health counselors, but also coaches in personal and professional development as well as instructors of meditation and breath work.

launches.title: Finito - Quit smoking in 4 weeks with a self-hypnosis app
launches.tagline: The world's first evidence-based digital therapeutic to help people quit smoking with hypnotherapy
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Hypnotherapy makes smokers [10x more likely](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/8881046_Clinical_Hypnosis_For_Smoking_Cessation_Preliminary_Results_of_a_Three-Session_Intervention) to quit smoking than going it alone and can be [more effective](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0965229913002100) than nicotine replacement therapy. We’ve created Finito, a self-hypnosis app that helps people quit with 15-minute daily sessions, educational readings, and stop-craving tools.

Check out the app on [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/finito-quit-smoking-hypnosis/id1624855382?platform=iphone) or the [Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mindsethealth.quit)! Learn more at [tryfinito.com](http://tryfinito.com).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65293&key=user_uploads/243817/f42fb187-6edc-4a8a-8fd2-70a47a576ddf)

**❌ The problem**

Smoking is one of the biggest public health threats the world faces today and yet doesn’t have the attention it sorely needs. It’s responsible for 1 in 5 deaths and an economic cost of more than [$300 billion a year in the US](https://www.cdc.gov/tobacco/data_statistics/fact_sheets/adult_data/cig_smoking/index.htm) alone.

While half of smokers made a quit attempt in the past year, research shows it may take up to 30 attempts before they are successful. This is because nicotine patches and gums do not address the emotional and habitual factors behind smoking and access to in-person therapeutic support is limited.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65293&key=user_uploads/243817/d8b07f51-9847-4ee2-bcf6-f1e3055e45b8)

**✨ Our solution**

We’ve joined up with world-leading neuroscientist Dr Gary Elkins to create an easy-to-use app with a 4-week structured program that helps people quit smoking with 15-minute daily self-hypnosis sessions, educational readings, and stop-craving tools.

What distinguishes Finito from other smoking cessation solutions is that it addresses the underlying reasons that cause people to smoke in the first place, providing hypnotic suggestions to the subconscious to manage cravings, emotions, and habits.

The program is ideal for people who have tried to quit but have returned to smoking because it changes their unconscious smoking behavior and gives them the tools to self-manage their craving symptoms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65293&key=user_uploads/243817/95ead0b3-6059-4073-934b-5e984df16299)

**⚙️ How it works**

You may be familiar with hypnosis and its urban-legendary ability to help people stop smoking. Well, clinical studies show that hypnotherapy can actually be [10 times more effective](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/14768970/) than quitting without support and [more effective](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0965229913002100) than nicotine replacement therapy. And according to [neurobiological brain studies](https://academic.oup.com/cercor/article/27/8/4083/3056452?login=false), hypnotherapy activates areas of the [brain associated](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25365127/) with attention, motivation, and a sense of well-being.

Hypnosis isn't a therapy itself - it's a state of focused attention and heightened suggestibility that makes therapeutic techniques like CBT and guided imagery more effective. Hypnotherapy is like meditation but focused on health outcomes

**💙 Founders backstory**

We created Mindset Health to empower people to improve their health by unlocking the power of their mind. We’ve already helped 80,000 people manage their IBS with hypnotherapy with our app Nerva. And we’re really excited to help people finally quit smoking, many of whom are understandably anxious and depressed about a habit that has controlled their life for too long.

**Our ask**

1. Tell any friends or family you know who want to quit smoking
2. Investors: send us an email at [alex@mindsethealth.com](mailto:alex@mindsethealth.com)
3. Share this post to your network to spread the word about hypnotherapy!

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
The idea began in October 2012 on a bus from Jakarta to Bogor.

When the bus stopped for fuel, Fulcher noticed an older woman, a man, and a young child washing up with water from a roadside gutter. Meanwhile, a low-cost Android phone in the woman’s hand streamed YouTube.

Fulcher was shocked at the juxtaposition. How is 3G internet available on affordable smartphones but basic medical care not accessible? If mobile video could reach an ordinary phone, could a doctor do the same?

Before the bus reached Bogor, Fulcher had begun writing the first lines of what would become RingMD code. Over the following weeks, he hacked together a prototype and started going door to door at hospitals and clinics in Singapore to onboard physicians. The first version was a simple directory of doctors, with photographs, consultation prices, professional experience, and résumé information.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Access to healthcare is one of the most important things for anyone.  More than 3 billion people worldwide still lack it.  RingMD’s mission is to help bring access to affordable healthcare to as many people as possible.  RingMD works with governments to power their public health programs to extend their reach and impact.

launches.title: Legion Health — Autonomous medical care, starting with fully AI-powered psychiatric medication prescriptions
launches.tagline: Legion is building full-stack, AI-native care delivery system for medicine: from an AI-native clinic, to semi-autonomous care with clinician supervision, to fully autonomous care
launches.body:
Hi Y Combinator Community! We’re Yash, Danny, and Arthur, the founders of Legion Health.

At Legion, **we’re building autonomous medical care**, starting in psychiatry.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99205&key=user_uploads/616238/f421f535-9738-4e44-ab44-05bd70f7c1f1)

We previously launched Legion as an AI-native psychiatry clinic ([see here](https://www.ycombinator.com/launches/LT4-legion-health-world-class-ai-enabled-psychiatry-covered-by-insurance)). We’re relaunching now because we recently crossed an important threshold: Legion has received regulatory authorization for fully AI-powered renewals of psychiatric maintenance medications. To our knowledge, this makes Legion the first mental health company ever to have approval to let AI provide actual medical care.

This is a meaningful product update for us because it is the first time AI in Legion can directly execute a real clinical workflow in production. Until now, most of the value we created came from making the clinic itself dramatically more efficient by automating 95%+ of the admin work. This is different. This is AI-native care delivery moving from support work into clinical action inside a live, regulated system.

# TL;DR

Legion Health is building autonomous medical care. We started by building an AI-native psychiatry clinic, and we’re now launching the next step: in Utah, Legion has received regulatory authorization for AI-led renewals of eligible psychiatric maintenance medications.

We think this is an important proof point that medical care can move from clinician-led workflows, to AI-led workflows with supervision, and eventually to fully autonomous care in well-scoped pathways.

# The problem

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99205&key=user_uploads/616238/55fd5ce0-2b67-4eef-9477-8c6e0841bb56)

Psychiatry (mental health + medicine) is one of the clearest categories where a new site of care is needed.

The issue is not that people do not want care. It is that the system cannot deliver enough of it. There are too few psychiatric providers, too much administrative overhead, and too much friction between a patient needing help and a patient actually getting actionable clinical resolution.

Even in the simplest cases, the system breaks down. A patient who is stable on a medication that is already working can still be forced to wait days or weeks, book a visit, incur costs, chase the pharmacy, and spend time and energy navigating the process instead of getting better. That is not a small inconvenience. It is a direct consequence of a care model built around scarce clinician minutes and fragmented operations.

But continuity is the unit, not visits. Mental health care works best when care is longitudinal, not episodic; when the system can follow the patient over time, resolve routine needs quickly, and escalate humans when something truly requires human judgment.

That is why we believe psychiatry (and medicine in general) needs a new digital front door to care: one that is always available, clinically actionable, and connected to licensed clinicians whenever escalation is needed.

# Our progression: AI-native clinic -> semi-autonomous care -> fully autonomous care

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99205&key=user_uploads/616238/949a0a17-f47b-466c-9948-e66ad8e57741)

We have always thought the path to autonomy matters just as much as the destination.

### Phase 1: AI-native psychiatry clinic

Phase 1 was the AI-native clinic. We built a real psychiatry clinic where human psychiatrists and AI agents work together to provide high-quality care directly to patients. That forced us to solve the hard, messy parts of the real world first: intake, scheduling, medical records, pharmacy coordination, prior authorizations, reimbursement, follow-up, and clinical escalation. In the process, we built a clinical + operational + reimbursement + regulatory stack in one system.

**Demo:** Garry Tan recently featured Legion on Y Combinator’s YouTube, and here we show our AI operating system that allows us to take care of a huge clinic with an extremely small admin team, using automations and agents.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rWUWfj_PqmM&t=273s>

The Legion segment starts around 4:33.

### Phase 2: Semi-autonomous care with clinician supervision (today)

Phase 2 is what we are launching now: semi-autonomous care with clinician supervision. In this model, AI handles the default workflow in narrow, safety-scoped pathways, and clinicians supervise exceptions, ambiguity, and higher-complexity cases. The Utah renewals workflow is our first real example of this. It is the bridge from AI assisting clinicians to AI executing narrowly scoped clinical work, with clinician escalation when needed.

**Our social media and press launch for our first-ever pilot in mental health:**

LinkedIn: <https://www.linkedin.com/posts/yashmpatel1_today-we-took-another-huge-step-toward-truly-activity-7443320080760942592-27FX?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAACKkTu8BFJG1YHsaT6kWOskKDexaBBvfIn8>

X: <https://x.com/ArthurMacwaters/status/2037479229294874918?s=20>

Press release: <https://nypost.com/2026/03/27/business/artificial-intelligence-can-now-prescribe-mental-health-drugs>

### Phase 3: Fully autonomous care

Phase 3 is fully autonomous care in the future. Over time, we believe more workflows will move from clinician-led to AI-led with supervision, to fully autonomous in well-scoped pathways with hard guardrails, continuous auditing, and mandatory escalation when appropriate.

We do not think medicine jumps from zero to full autonomy overnight. We think it gets there one real workflow at a time.

# What we launched

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99205&key=user_uploads/616238/7dafbb1d-8746-47cb-b95c-2f59185fd011)

In Utah, Legion is rolling out AI-led renewals for eligible lower-risk psychiatric maintenance medications.

The workflow is intentionally narrow and safety-scoped. Patients explicitly opt in, are clearly told they are interacting with AI, go through identity verification, and complete a focused safety review grounded in medication and chart context. If anything is ambiguous, higher-risk, or out of scope, the case escalates to a clinician. Patients can also request human review at any point.

We started with renewals because renewals are a perfect example of what is broken in mental healthcare today, and because they are exactly the kind of routine, high-friction workflow that should eventually become software-handled by default inside a real care-delivery system.

# Why is this such an important step in healthcare AI?

At first glance, a refill may sound narrow. We think that is exactly why it matters.

If AI cannot safely take on a constrained, repetitive, clinically meaningful workflow like renewals, then talk of autonomous care is still mostly theory. But if AI can safely execute a narrow clinical workflow in production, under explicit guardrails, with clinician escalation when needed, then the future starts to become concrete.

That is what this launch represents.

It is not just a faster refill. It is a proof point that care can start moving:

* from information to clinical action
* from copilot to autopilot
* from clinician-led workflows everywhere to clinician-led exceptions where they matter most
* from scarcity-based care to a system that can eventually support abundance

We think this is the next important step toward the real solution: medical care that is always available, high-frequency, longitudinal, more personalized, more consistent, and able to scale far beyond clinician supply alone.

# Why we had to build a clinic first

We did not start with a chatbot. We started by building the clinic.

That gave us something much more valuable than a thin AI layer: a unified data layer across records, prescriptions, scheduling, messaging, and follow-up; real operational feedback loops; clinician escalation pathways; and the infrastructure required to turn AI into actionable clinical resolution in the real world.

We think that is the real moat here.

The company that wins this category will not just have impressive models. It will own the default entry point to care, the patient relationship, the workflows, the regulatory trust, and the feedback loops required to make AI-native care delivery safe and real.

# Why we started Legion Health

My co-founders and I have known each other for 12 years and were roommates at Princeton. I ([Yash](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yashmpatel1/)) worked on Medicare and Medicaid payment policy at the Congressional Budget Office, [Danny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielgwilson/) brings deep AI and engineering experience from Microsoft, and [Arthur](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arthur-macwaters/) brings product and operations depth from McKinsey.

This problem is also deeply personal to us. We started Legion because we have seen how broken the medical system can feel when someone actually needs help, and we want to build the kind of system we wish existed for people we love.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99205&key=user_uploads/616238/0d9011ba-2414-4482-8dfa-b481fdf51a5c)

# Call to action

If you’re a **cracked engineer**, and you care about working on hard problems that impact real humans, we want to hear from you.

If you’re an **investor** who believes in a future where humans and AI work together to solve humanity’s biggest problems, we want to hear from you.

If you work in **digital health, payer partnerships, state/federal government, or AI-native care delivery** and want to talk, we want to hear from you.

Contact: [yash@legionhealth.com](mailto:yash@legionhealth.com)

launches.body:
# **🔍 TL;DR:**

For patients, we deliver world-class psychiatric care covered by insurance. For providers, our tech + LLM agents reduce administrative burden, increase payments, and enable high-quality care at scale. Check us out on our [website](https://legionhealth.com/)—if you’re in Texas and need care, we’d love to help.

Hi everyone! We’re [Yash](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yashmpatel1/), [Danny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielgwilson/), and [Arthur](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arthur-macwaters/)— and we're on a mission to build the largest network of psychiatric providers in the country and integrate LLMs into every facet of delivering care, ensuring patients can access high-quality, affordable treatment at scale.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82526&key=user_uploads/616238/b8caac8c-b744-4be6-9f78-c1e7cba87314)

# **💔 Problem: Finding an available psychiatrist who accepts insurance can be brutal**

In the United States, only [around half of psychiatrists](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamapsychiatry/fullarticle/1785174) accept commercial health insurance, compared to over 90% of other medical specialists. This rate is [even lower](https://www.healthaffairs.org/doi/10.1377/hlthaff.2017.0325) for specific insurance plans. Moreover, [less than 20%](https://www.notion.so/Transcript-Patient-Messaging-11fb811d9b614ea5bf55b52445aee739?pvs=21) of psychiatrists are accepting new patients. For those who are, the median wait time for an in-person initial appointment is over 60 days.

Many psychiatrists avoid taking insurance because the financial and administrative burdens outweigh the benefits. After covering administrative staff (scheduling, billing, patient support), paying for office space, and disputing insurance denials and underpayments, little profit remains for the psychiatrist.

For patients with serious mental health concerns, this lack of access and affordability can literally cost lives. The three of us deeply care about mental health and have personally experienced the difficulty of finding high-quality, affordable psychiatric care for ourselves, our family, and our friends.

# **🌱 Opportunity: A huge and growing need**

Post-COVID, [around 32% of U.S. adults](https://www.kff.org/other/state-indicator/adults-reporting-symptoms-of-anxiety-or-depressive-disorder-during-covid-19-pandemic/?currentTimeframe=0&selectedRows=%7B%22states%22:%7B%22all%22:%7B%7D%7D,%22wrapups%22:%7B%22united-states%22:%7B%7D%7D%7D&sortModel=%7B%22colId%22:%22Location%22,%22sort%22:%22asc%22%7D) experience mental health conditions annually, equating to about 83 million people. [Approximately 50%](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/reports/rpt39443/2021NSDUHFFRRev010323.pdf) of these individuals, or 42 million, do not receive necessary treatment. About 25% of those with mental health issues, or 10 million people, require psychiatric care (rather than perhaps just therapy). With a conservative annual cost of $2,500 per patient, this translates to an unmet market opportunity of approximately $25 billion. The demand for psychiatric services is growing at [about 4.1% annually](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/us-psychiatry-clinic-market-report). Additionally, [over 60% of U.S. counties](https://www.aamc.org/news/growing-psychiatrist-shortage-enormous-demand-mental-health-services) lack a psychiatrist, leaving these areas particularly underserved.

# **💡 Solution: Using tech + AI to make high-quality psychiatric care viable and scalable**

Legion Health is a network of psychiatric providers delivering world-class care to insured patients. Our software and AI dramatically reduce costs by minimizing capital expenses through telehealth and lowering operational costs with AI agents that enhance workflows and manage patient care with minimal human intervention.

By directly hiring our providers, we can quickly implement technology in a sandbox environment. Furthermore, as we scale, our stacking LLM agents continuously improve, enhancing care quality and patient experience. Unlike other VC-backed mental health companies (e.g., Betterhelp, Cerebral), we 1) accept insurance, 2) emphasize high-quality and ethical care, and 3) have genuine AI expertise.

At Legion Health, most patients:

* See a psychiatric provider within a week.
* Pay $30 or less out of pocket.
* Pick up their medication from the pharmacy within 24 hours.
* Receive rapid responses to messages from their provider or our front desk.
* Actually see an improvement in their mental health due to high-quality treatment.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82526&key=user_uploads/616238/76d1fa28-a33e-4de9-bc7c-901e11d31105)

# **📢 Asks**

1. If you or someone you know in Texas needs psychiatric care, we'd love to help and gather feedback for product improvement.
   * Sign up or refer patients using this link: [access this link](https://legionhealth.com/)
2. We're hiring mission-driven, world-class individuals for the following roles. We’d love introductions to any potential candidates in your network:
   * AI Engineer (preferably with experience in autonomous driving or machine learning)
   * [Technical Growth/Product Marketing Lead](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/legion-health/jobs/9JHdQqJ-technical-product-marketing-lead-legion-health-y-combinator-startup) (preferably consumer-focused)
   * Product Designer (preferably consumer-focused)

launches.title: Clara by Clinikally: Your Full-Stack AI Assistant for Skin & Hair Health
launches.tagline: Meet Clara, the AI dermatologist assistant that helps you analyze concerns, build routines, decode prescriptions, and discover the right products, all in one conversation.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Over the last 3 years, Clinikally has helped millions of users make better skin and hair health decisions through its **dermatology-led commerce and care platform**. Clara started as an AI skin analysis product, and today it has evolved into a **full-stack AI assistant for dermatology**; combining analysis, guidance, product discovery, routine building, and prescription support in one experience.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90878&key=user_uploads/480320/ca033475-82fe-42d1-a02f-c81449db06f5)

## 🤕 The Problem

**The global challenge:** 3 billion people face skin issues, yet 90% can't access dermatologists due to cost and availability barriers.

Skin and hair care decisions are still fragmented. Users jump between social media advice, search results, product catalogs, prescriptions they don’t fully understand, and doctor visits that are too expensive or too hard to access regularly.

**India's crisis:**

* 1 [dermatologist](https://clinikally.com/products/video-consult-with-a-skin-hair-specialist?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=290525+yc_launch_post) per 100,000 people
* Consultations often require long journeys + weeks of waiting + month's skincare budget in fees
* 70% of Indians live with untreated chronic skin concerns

Even when people know they need help, they usually don’t know where to begin: What is this concern? Which products are right for me? How do I build a routine? What does my prescription actually do? **Clara is built for that exact gap.**

## 💡 Our Solution

Clara is your **AI assistant for skin and hair health**. You can start with a face or hair analysis, ask Clara questions in chat, get tailored routines, receive product recommendations, and even upload a prescription to understand what it means and which products match it.

Instead of giving users a static report and leaving them there, Clara helps them move all the way from confusion to clarity to action. That makes Clara useful not just once, but every time someone has a skincare or haircare decision to make.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90878&key=user_uploads/480320/9c355c2d-b7dd-4382-a40e-9f99ee36597d)

**What Clara can do:**

* Analyze face and hair concerns with AI-powered flows.
* Recommend personalized routines based on user concerns.
* Suggest relevant products with dermatology-backed guidance.
* Explain prescriptions and match them to useful products.
* Answer ongoing skin and hair questions in a conversational interface

## 💡 How Clara Works

1. Start with your concern. Scan your face, choose hair/scalp analysis, upload a prescription, or just ask a question in chat.
2. Clara understands the context and gives you structured guidance instead of generic internet advice.
3. You get personalized recommendations across routines, products, and next steps.
4. When needed, Clara can work as the intelligent layer connecting users to Clinikally’s broader dermatology ecosystem.

## **Why this matters**

Most skincare tools do one thing well: analysis, product discovery, or consultation intake. Clara is designed to unify those moments into one assistant experience. The result is a product that feels less like a calculator and more like an always-available dermatologist copilot.

For users, that means faster decisions and better clarity. For us, it means Clara can become the highest-intent entry point into personalized dermatology journeys across Clinikally.

## **Try Clara**

You can now use Clara to:

* Analyze your skin or hair
* Ask dermatology questions
* Build a customized routine
* Get product suggestions
* Upload a prescription for instant guidance

**⭐⭐ Try Clara here:** [clara.clinikally.com](https://clara.clinikally.com) **⭐⭐**\
**Open the assistant directly:** [clara.clinikally.com/chat](https://clara.clinikally.com/chat)

**More exciting features are coming**: Scalp scanning and cross-platform mobile apps for our full-stack e-pharmacy and [dermatologist consult](https://clinikally.com/products/video-consult-with-a-skin-hair-specialist?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=290525+yc_launch_post) platform launching later this year. Stay tuned!

_— Arjun & the Clinikally Team_

## 🚀 Our Ask

We’d love feedback on where Clara feels most valuable: analysis, routine generation, product guidance, prescription understanding, or conversational support. We’re especially interested in edge cases where users move between multiple needs in one journey, because that is exactly the behavior we are building Clara around.

Check Clara out at[ ](https://withjanus.com/)[clara.clinikally.com](https://clara.clinikally.com)

Email us with feedback, thoughts and suggestions at [developers@clinikally.com](mailto:team@withjanus.com)

### **What is** [**Clinikally**](https://www.clinikally.com)**?**

A new kind of digital health, Clinikally is India’s one-stop platform for telehealth & doctor-recommended products in Dermatology, Nutrition and Overall Wellness.

We routinely treat leading indications like eczema, acne, hyperpigmentation, and pattern alopecia across 500 cities in India.

* Connect with a specialty provider in under 30 minutes (next-day appointments available as well)
* Receive doorstep delivery of a personalized treatment plan
* Get products from our in-house [online pharmacy](https://www.clinikally.com/collections/all)

* 30 months since launch: Over 1,000,000 users across 500 cities

300 million Indians face some skin/hair issue, and there is only 1 dermatologist available for every 200,000. While large numbers of patients often visit major dermatology clinics in cities like Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru from far and wide, it becomes cost-prohibitive and inconvenient to consistently follow up in-person.

Moreover, the acceleration of digital health driven by COVID lockdowns has further demonstrated to physicians and patients alike that a growing number of derma conditions can be treated through a combination of telehealth and a preset number of dermatologist-recommended products.

We are democratizing dermatology in India like never before, condition by condition, and shipping solutions that actually work.

Founder is a **Stanford CS Grad + Stanford Med Researcher**; Chief Medical Officer is a **Cambridge-trained dermatologist** who runs one of India’s largest dermatology practices; Head of Ops has 15+ years at **Allergan.**

We are approaching this problem with extensive experience from the multi-faceted angles of digital health, clinical dermatology, and pharma.

launches.body:
We’re [Tara](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/196433) and [Carly](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/922870), and we’re excited to introduce [Almond:](https://almondobgyn.com/) we’re building a better healthcare experience for women 🌸 ✨

TL;DR

Almond is like One Medical but for women’s health: we make it easy to get great ObGyn care, both at our in-person office and over telehealth.

**We’re growing quickly.** Even before we opened our first location we hit $90k run rate revenue, and we’re booking out 3 weeks in advance.

**You can book an appointment with us in LA.** Our first full service clinic just opened in Los Angeles (see a couple of photos below)!! Book an appointment at [www.almondobgyn.com](http://www.almondobgyn.com) or call 424-237-8406. Share with your friends and family to help the women in your life have a better option for ObGyn care. 

**Membership is affordable and we take all major insurance.**

* Membership is $250 annually but our founding members can get their first year of membership for $150. 
* For visits, you can either use insurance or pay out of pocket. We accept Cigna, Aetna, Blue Shield, Anthem Blue Cross, and United HealthCare.

### ObGyn today is broken

As women, we’ve had too many frustrating experiences with our ObGyn care. We may love our doctors but the process _around_ seeing the doctor can be terrible: long hold times to schedule, waiting a month or longer for an appointment, and often leaving an appointment with unclear next steps. Our modern world gives us so many great service experiences, yet when it comes to the most important aspect of our lives – our health – we are forced to put up with a slow, confusing process. 

Billions of dollars have been poured into modernizing primary care, yet women are still waiting for a better option for ObGyn care. The overturning of Roe is a harsh reminder that women still aren’t given the resources or the rights to be full decision makers over their own bodies. We are building Almond because women deserve better. 

### Why better ObGyn care matters

The impact of better ObGyn care is massive. There are 130M women in the US and they all need ObGyn care every year. On top of that, ObGyn is where women typically have their first intense, high stakes experiences with healthcare. We spend $200B a year on ObGyn care in the US; it is the second largest specialty by spend, after only primary care. Yet currently, women don’t have a brand they can trust and where they know they’ll have a great experience.

At Almond we believe women should have an extraordinary care experience: one that offers quality, transparent care, delivered faster. 

### We’re freeing up the ObGyn’s time so they can focus on what matters most

One of the first problems to tackle in ObGyn care is that doctor time is used inefficiently, wasting already limited ObGyn capacity. This makes access to care slow, and patients often feel their questions are unaddressed or they get unfit care.

We’re able to make care more convenient because we use doctor time better – we build software tools to take unnecessary tasks off their plates and we hire a wider range of care providers, not just doctors. By freeing up time for ObGyns they can spend more time on what matters most – delivering great care in every interaction, and seeing the patients that need their attention sooner.

We also believe getting [ObGyn](https://almondobgyn.com/) care should feel like a true-self care experience for patients, so our offices and software are designed to be convenient, reliable, and intuitive.

Hey YC, we're Vaughn and Victor, and we're excited to announce the public launch of [Kivo Health](https://kivohealth.com?utm_source=launch_yc&utm_medium=post&utm_id=launch&utm_content=toplink)!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69058&key=user_uploads/29150/dd09bb20-ff16-41d8-ac17-e02af5f068d4)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69058&key=user_uploads/29150/e395a0d4-305a-4d2c-b658-213602df0192)

**We treat chronic lung disease with rehab over Zoom.** We offer an 8-week remote program that keeps people out of the hospital, and can save payers $6,000 per patient by reducing hospital stays.

# How we help

Chronic lung disease affects 16M people in the US, resulting in $50B in annual spend due to recurrent hospitalizations.

Pulmonary rehab (PR) is like physical rehab for your lungs. It includes guided exercise, breathing techniques, and a full education program which teaches people to manage their lung condition.

PR has strong clinical evidence: it can improve clinical outcomes, reduce hospital bed-days by 62%, save payers between $6-10k for every patient, and help patients feel better.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69058&key=user_uploads/29150/5bfdd176-ce16-4965-a9e6-82a8a5d7e4e9)

This life changing therapy has been around for decades, but tragically only 3% of eligible patients are getting it. Why? Access.

Often, people with COPD or other lung disease find it challenging to walk up a flight of stairs. Traveling 30-45 minutes to a PR center twice a week is a lot harder, especially for people without transport or the ability to pay for gas and parking.

**Kivo Health solves access by providing telehealth PR**, so patients can be treated comfortably at home.

# **How it works**

We ship people our Kivo Kit, which has a cell-connected iPad, a Bluetooth pulse oximeter, and exercise equipment.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69058&key=user_uploads/29150/dd5cd6c7-0ead-424b-aa90-b30c62bedc77)

Patients join live video sessions twice a week for 2 months, with one of our talented respiratory therapists.

During the sessions, our therapists are:

* Monitoring our patients with realtime pulse oximetry
* Improving their lung function with exercise
* Teaching them breathing techniques, inhaler use, and a lot of other key lessons.

# **Wins**

We're building Kivo to help patients get access to pulmonary rehab. But it's the stories that make us feel great about what we're doing. Here's a few examples.

1\. One patient told us that she'd been using her inhaler wrong for over 20 years, until she learned proper technique from Kivo.

2\. Another patient told us that she loved Kivo so much, she wrote a letter to her pulmonologist telling him that he should refer all of his patients to our program.

3\. During our first cohort, we had a patient that was feeling the signs of a lung exacerbation one day. These are dangerous because people often end up in the ER, or even full hospitalization (which costs $19k on average!). Because she had learned from Kivo how to recognize the signs of an exacerbation, she immediately got a course of steroids from her doctor and felt better quickly. This could have made the difference between a hospital visit and relaxing at home.

# **How you can help**

* If you have a family member or friend with COPD or other lung disease, tell them about [Kivo Health](https://kivohealth.com?utm_source=launch_yc&utm_medium=post&utm_id=launch&utm_content=asks)! Note - patients need to be referred by their physician.
* Also, we'd appreciate any intros to pulmonologists - email us at [hello@kivohealth.com](mailto:hello@kivohealth.com).

Much love, **Victor and Vaughn**

launches.tagline: We help patients make lifestyle changes to reverse Type 2 Diabetes, covered by existing health insurance
launches.body:
**tl:dr;** LifestyleRx provides virtual care for Type 2 diabetes reversal.  Our doctors guide patients through lifestyle changes to reverse the underlying process of diabetes, billing insurance so we can deliver life-changing outcomes at little or no cost to the patient.  We have 2,000 patients in our program today and are adding 500 more every month.

 

We’re Dan, Brendan, Jason, and Jack, the cofounders of [LifestyleRx](https://lifestylerx.io)!

 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73770&key=user_uploads/1247082/8009148c-572c-4884-b57d-90dc452a5111)

 

We are all former health tech founders who previously built and exited EMR businesses in Canada.  We’re united by our passion for helping diabetic patients as we all have close family who are diabetic.  And we’re also rooted in a real-world understanding of the complex healthcare system, warts and all, from our years working in it.

 

### **Another Diabetes Startup?**

The market is full of employer-facing diabetes management apps that haven’t worked. Diabetes costs more than $237B in direct medical expenses every year, and there are >100M Americans with either prediabetes or Type 2 diabetes.

The solution to this problem needs two things:

1. A focus on diabetes reversal, where sustained drug-free remission is the goal.  Lots of apps reduce diabetes costs by \~5%.  We aim for 95%.
2. Use the healthcare system we have – bill fee-for-service, accept patient referrals, be covered for everyone with insurance – and build a lean operation to power it.

 

We’re building a modern virtual care provider that can meet this need, combining the best of compassionate physician care with infinitely scalable technology to fit profitably into the real world of insurance reimbursement. 

  

### **46% of Patients Reach the Remission Range**

Today we have 2,000 patients in our program, and we deliver 46% of them into the A1C range for diabetic remission – that is, the lab range for someone without diabetes.  This adds years to their lives, offsets hundreds of thousands in lifetime healthcare costs, and significantly reduces the risk of heart disease and cognitive decline.

![timeline](https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/D5622AQFdJxzZM_nMjA/feedshare-shrink_2048_1536/0/1687880971696?e=1694044800&v=beta&t=ofkErOL_pd8t3nbIqMHPtP0_zGCuKCzHaOntjhNkubA)

 

### **Doing It Profitably**

The key to making all of this work is provider leverage.  We make technology that gives our doctors superpowers.  They can complete documentation in a fraction of the time of their peers (<20%) and handle group medical sessions with ease (one of the best-reimbursed services in healthcare because it’s usually so arduous).

We built our own EMR platform, connecting every decision physicians make to real patient data – including readiness-for-change, behavioral momentum, and more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73770&key=user_uploads/1247082/631140dd-4176-432a-a0dc-e736b9d078e4)

 

Our patients spend only a couple of hours with physicians but have more than 20x hours of connection with their physicians – as they learn through personalized content, understand their disease through interactive reports that contextualize their data, and work step-by-step through implementing their recommended lifestyle changes.  In the future we will leverage LLMs to answer patient questions and guide them through changes, further increasing this provider leverage ratio.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73770&key=user_uploads/1247082/a6e571be-d442-4c12-a901-97437813c98b)

 

 

### **We’re going to shrink this market**

Diabetes is a $237B market in the US.  Diabetes reversal and maintenance will be a $36B market.  For every $1 spent on diabetes reversal, we offset $15 spent on diabetes care.  And that’s great because the healthcare system needs those dollars for other things.

Type 2 diabetes is just the beginning, as lifestyle medicine can also transform costs across a range of cardiometabolic diseases.  LifestyleRx is the lifestyle prescription for those diseases, and we intend to build a solution that can scale to the size of this vast problem.

\-

To get in touch, email [jason@lifestylerx.io](mailto:jason@lifestylerx.io)

long_description:
RonanRX is a full-stack pharmaceutical company, starting with personalized peptides and GLP-1s.

In our first 10 weeks, we went from having no pharmacy to being licensed in 33 states. Since launch, we’ve grown 50% week over week.

We manufacture the medications ourselves, sell directly to patients, and eliminate the layers of middlemen that make prescription drugs more expensive.

What makes this possible is AI.

Traditional pharmaceutical companies are built to manufacture one drug for millions of people. RonanRX is purpose-built to personalize treatment for each patient: different biology, different response, different dose.

Patients come directly to RonanRX or through doctors using our platform.
